verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a compliance SaaS, but the evidence shows no documented bulk, batch, or multi-item operation. The API v2 docs list only per-item CRUD endpoints (Create/Update/Delete Control, Policy, Evidence Library Item, Custom Connection) and list/search reads. Scripting loops over single-item calls, or prompting the MCP server, would be developer building blocks rather than a shipped bulk capability, so they earn no credit.
